notes: BPR 2.0 FIXED and re-verified through a REAL renderer (PowerPoint COM, 40 slides exported to PNG + PDF). Root cause of the clipping: the previous QA composited slides with PIL and my own text-wrap estimate, so it could not see how PowerPoint wraps. Title layout now measures real Calibri metrics, adjusts size, and places the rule after the lines actually needed; body content follows that rule. Split-row charts: legend moved above the plot and the unnamed remainder now drawn as an explicit Other/uncoded leg. Render QA over all 40 PNGs: no title-rule collisions, no bottom overrun, no text on bars, no empty slides.
